profile.headline: Software Engineer at HVR Software
profile.summary: Software Engineer with over 20 years of R&D and support experience involving mission critical enterprise software.  Extensive experience in C/C++ under Unix (Linux, SunOS, HP-UX, AIX) / Windows environments.  Software background includes Oracle OCI, Oracle Pro*C, Forms, SQL, Python, AWS, Azure.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Escalation Lead
positions.description:
• Coordinated investigation up to resolution of support escalated cases between R&D team and support
• Handled high severity cases through data manipulation, bug fixes via hot fixes or triaging issues for further R&D analysis
• Maintained and supported various modules of enterprise software (SharePlex) used for Oracle database data replication.  Various modules included Oracle data capture, data manipulation / transmission as well as confirmation of replicated data integrity.
• Developed enhancements/features of said product based on product roadmap using Agile methodology
• Tested / Maintained code under Unix (Linux, AIX, SunOS, HP-UX) and Windows on AWS, Azure or on premises environments with various Oracle Database setups including versions from 10g through 19c, and configurations such as RAC, ASM

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained and developed features for various modules of SharePlex -- an Oracle database replication software used for disaster recovery, high availability and report / load offloading currently used by multiple fortune 500 companies.    
• Tuned legacy C/C++ code by using various tools (memory leak/corruption detection such as Electric fence, Valgrind,  Purify or security/quality using Coverity and Veracode)
• Developed enhancements/features of said product based on product roadmap using Agile methodology
• New features implemented include conflict resolution, horizontal partitioning, various performance enhancements for different product modules

positions.title: Customer Support Lead / Software Maintenance Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented requirements from customer regarding any enhancements or bug fixes on warehouse management software built on Oracle Forms / Pro*C / Unix Platform
• Implemented changes to certify Y2K compatibility requirements for Warehouse management software
• Primary contact for Optum 24x7 customer support  (Xerox Rochester DC).
